notes.title: Demo Depth Ascend
notes.content:
It's available, yes!
The DEMO of Depth Ascend:
I've released the DEMO version of the game so you can cool off this summer while exploring these first four levels, which are the tutorial of the game.
You'll be able to experience the feeling of being a humble squid in a vast ocean world while, on the run, you adapt to its control, surpassing yourself in each game.

Enjoy and see you soon.
